stem.en: If every successful cell eventually disappears, how can life continue?

text.en: Cells spontaneously generate from non-living matter when needed.

feedback.en: Modern biology shows that new cells arise only from existing cells, not by spontaneous generation.

text.en: Cells reproduce by duplicating their instructions and dividing to form new cells.
Life relies entirely on organisms surviving forever without dividing.

feedback.en: Individual organisms eventually die. Life continues because cells reproduce, not because organisms live forever.

explanation.en: Cells preserve life's continuity by copying their DNA before dividing. Each daughter cell receives its own complete set of genetic instructions.
